author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a side-view car (sloped rear window and windshield, flat roof, wheels on the underside) split into two halves by a zigzag crack, under a seven-point blast. Halves mirror about x=24 with a constant crack gap. A six-point star was rejected because it read as a Star of David, and a five-point star because it read as an arrow.
omissions: The source's full-circle wheels became semicircular wheel bumps on the underside, and the halves are drawn upright rather than tilted, so the crack gap stays at full clearance. The blast is a closed seven-point star; the source's is open at the bottom.
drawing_plan: Mirrored car silhouette cut by a steep zigzag crack shifted 10 units; seven-point burst polygon centred above the crack.
lucide_reference: car (side profile), star/sparkles spike construction for the burst
